Name: Fallen London Mushroom Wines

v1.0.0:
This mod adds Greyfields, Morelways, Broken Giant, Amanita Wine, and Creeping Willow Wine to your Stardew Valley game, as based on items in the browser game Fallen London.

Wait, isn't it Amanita [i]Sherry[/i] and [i]Strangling[/i] Willow [i]Absinthe[/i]?
Well, yes, but these are the non-distilled versions. I might add the distilled, proper versions at a later point. Once I've figured out if there is a way to make a mod dependant on one of a list of other mods.

Which mushroom becomes which wine?
Pretty straightforward:
Common Mushroom -> Greyfields
Red Mushroom -> Amanita Wine
Morel -> Morelways
Purple Mushroom -> Creeping Willow
Chanterelle -> Broken Giant

Downloads.Description: Please make sure to sell all instances of Creeping Willow before you do a clean install.
